description: Set or replace a live event's cover image. Provide ONE of: image_base64 (the raw image bytes — use this to set an image attached or generated in the chat, passing its FULL bytes) OR image_url (a public https link, fetched + re-hosted durably). png/jpeg/webp/gif, ≤10 MB, complete image only (truncated payloads rejected). If your runtime can't move the full bytes into the call, host the image at a public URL and use image_url. Requires event_id; you must be a host.
name: set_event_image
title: Set Event Image
